corpus.why: MSYS rewrites /refs/heads/main to C:\msys64\refs\heads\main (root-relative POSIX), which is not a git ref
colon rev:path is not POSIX-absolute; still excluded by policy
MSYS special-cases /dev/null to NUL, destroying the Unix-device token
legitimate /c/Users path must convert or clone silently no-ops
redirect target must convert; unconverted write truncates the wrong file

evidence.claim: Under one scoped configuration, /refs/heads/main survives unconverted and /c/Users/probe/repo converts to C:\Users\probe\repo with the clone marker present.

probes.raw_output: {"clone_intended_exists": true, "clone_marker": "C:\\Users\\probe\\repo\\.git\\HEAD", "device_corrupted": true, "device_observed": "NUL", "device_original": "/dev/null", "device_unconverted": false, "env_clone": {}, "posix_converted": true, "posix_observed": "C:\\Users\\probe\\repo", "posix_original": "/c/Users/probe/repo", "revision_corrupted": true, "revision_observed": "C:\\msys64\\refs\\heads\\main", "revision_original": "/refs/heads/main", "revision_unconverted": false}

evidence.claim: A global-suppression fixture (MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 / EXCL=*) fails the legitimate-path case: clone is a silent no-op and redirect truncates the intended target. Scoped is not equivalent to global.

evidence_requirement: Both-direction evidence: a revision argument surviving unconverted, AND a legitimate POSIX path argument still being converted correctly under the same configuration. A run showing only one direction is half a proof.

negative_controls.description: mode=none must rewrite /refs/heads/main and /dev/null, proving the probe can see the broken state.
MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 must leave /c/Users/probe/repo unconverted and must not create the intended clone marker.
Unconverted redirect target writes elsewhere and leaves the intended Windows path empty.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0466: argument-scoped MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL, never MSYS_NO_PATHCONV globally. Both directions proved under one scoped configuration; global fixture fails the POSIX-path case. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. SENTINEL:IMP-0466:PATHCONV-ARGUMENT-SCOPED
question: Prove path-conversion suppression is COMMAND-aware and ARGUMENT-aware: applied around revision-shaped and device-path arguments, never globally.

residual_unknowns.claim: This Linux worktree does not host Git Bash/MSYS. Evidence is from the MSYS conversion model in tools/shell/pathconv.py (drive-letter /c/ → C:\, root-relative /refs → C:\msys64\refs, /dev/null → NUL, MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL prefix matching). prepare_subprocess_env is the production hook for a real spawn.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Re-run probe1 and probe2 under Git Bash on Windows, comparing child argv (MSYS_DEBUG or a wrapper) to the model.

resolution_table.note: Clone happening is the intended Windows file existing, not an exit code. Global suppression is a fixture, not the production path.
